{{Engineer infobox}}

'''Colonel Bris Dekker''' is a retired Federal Navy officer and ship [[Engineers|Engineer]] based at '''Dekker's Yard''' in the permit-locked '''Sol''' system. His naval career included service in an elite reconnaissance squadron, and the Federal Navy continues to consult him on changes to frame shift technology.<ref name="edwiki-dekker">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Bris_Dekker Bris Dekker], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game description and legacy Engineer record.</ref>

Dekker provides Grade 4 [[Frame Shift Drive Interdictor]] Engineering and Grade 3 [[Frame Shift Drive]] Engineering.<ref name="inara-dekker">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/14/ Colonel Bris Dekker — Engineer], INARA; current access, reputation, and service record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Dekker's Yard is a surface Engineer base on Iapetus, approximately 4,737 Ls from Sol's arrival point.<ref name="inara-yard">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52834/ Dekker's Yard — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Sol normally requires the permit awarded at the Federal Navy Auxiliary rank of '''Petty Officer'''. This physical access requirement is separate from Dekker's Friendly-Federation meeting requirement.<ref name="edwiki-sol">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Sol Sol], Elite Dangerous Wiki; permit requirement.</ref><ref name="edwiki-fed-ranks">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Federation/Ranks Federation ranks], Elite Dangerous Wiki; current rank-unlock table.</ref>

{{Important|A referral from [[Juri Ishmaak]] does not grant the Sol permit. A Commander must be able to enter Sol before travelling to Dekker's Yard.}}

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| Receive a referral from [[Juri Ishmaak]] after reaching Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4.
|-
| Meeting
| Reach at least '''Friendly''' reputation with the Federation.
|-
| Unlock
| Provide the Federal combat-bond value displayed in the Engineer invitation.
|}

Current records report an unlock of either '''1,000,000 CR''' or '''10,000,000 CR''' in Federal combat bonds, depending on a condition that has not been established. Check the invitation shown to your Commander rather than assuming either amount applies universally.<ref name="inara-dekker" />

Federation reputation and Federal Navy Auxiliary rank are separate progress tracks. The former satisfies Dekker's meeting requirement; the latter normally supplies the Sol permit.

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-dekker" />}}

== Reputation ==

Reputation with Dekker can be increased by:

* crafting Engineering modifications at Dekker's Yard; or
* handing in bounty vouchers at Dekker's Yard.<ref name="inara-dekker" />

The bounty vouchers used for reputation are separate from the Federal combat bonds required for the initial unlock. Dekker does not provide a direct referral to another Engineer.

Dekker is the highest-grade Frame Shift Drive Interdictor Engineer in the Bubble. [[Mel Brandon]] provides Grade 5 Interdictor Engineering in the Colonia region.<ref name="inara-dekker" />

See [[Frame Shift Drive Interdictor]] and [[Frame Shift Drive]] for module details, and [[Engineering]] for blueprint and Experimental Effect mechanics.

== Referral position ==

Dekker is one of two direct referrals from [[Juri Ishmaak]]:

<pre>
Felicity Farseer
└── Juri Ishmaak
    ├── Colonel Bris Dekker
    └── The Sarge
</pre>

[[The Sarge]] is a parallel referral, not a prerequisite for Dekker. Dekker is terminal in the current referral network.<ref name="inara-dekker" />
